message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data on the current air quality in Los Angeles. For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

* **AirNow** (https://www.airnow.gov) – provides real‑time AQI values for U.S. cities, including Los Angeles.
* **AQICN** (https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/) – offers live AQI readings and historical trends.
* Local news outlets or the City of Los Angeles website often publish daily air‑quality updates.

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also use a weather app that includes AQI data (many smartphones have built‑in air‑quality widgets).
